name: Nem cho huyen
summary: Fermented pork from Tuy Phước. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says it is neither as soft as nem Thủ Đức nor as sweet as nem Lai Vung or nem An Cựu. The city tourism introduction names it and does not describe it.
origin: Huyện Tuy Phước. The verse on the provincial portal says Vĩnh Thạnh. A restaurant that uses the name is not a pick.
texture: The portal says a bite is chewy, nubbly, sour, and crisp, with a clean sweetness.
howToEat: Peel the two banana-leaf wraps and the guava leaf. Eat it fresh, or grilled over charcoal, with coriander, perilla, rau răm, banana, star fruit, cucumber, garlic, and chili, and fish sauce or soy.
The portal also describes a rice-paper roll it calls bánh cuốn: a skewer of nem, herbs, and a few fried chả ram. The sauce decides the roll.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Huyện Tuy Phước. The portal does not give a city street in Quy Nhon.
seoTitle: Nem cho huyen — Tuy Phuoc pork
seoDescription: Nem chợ huyện is Tuy Phước pork, chewy and sour, eaten fresh or grilled, or rolled in rice paper. The provincial portal names no Quy Nhon street. Check on arrival.
